about_the_game:
Step into the world of ancient myths and craft your own legend with this free DLC! Designed with meticulous attention to detail, this Achilles figurine is yours to 3D print, paint, and display – whether you want to decorate your space like the halls of Olympus or or keep a hero by your side for daily inspiration.

Contents:

  • Pre-supported and regular STL file packs to 3D-print the Achilles figurine yourself (by default it’s 23 cm high and 11,5 cm wide or 9 x 4,5 inches respectively);

  • The download size is 280 MB and 749 MB after zip extraction;

  • The files are configured exclusively for resin 3D printing.

How to use:

  • On the STEAM portal/application, enter the phrase "Achilles: Legends Untold" or "Achilles: Survivor" into the search bar;

  • From the list of search results, select the free DLC with the printable figurine;

  • Click the "Download" button;

  • You'll find the files in the "Extras/Immortal Legend" folder inside the game's main directory (Right-click on the game in your library > "Manage" > "Browse Local Files").

Now you’re ready to start printing!

PS: Don't forget to send us a picture when you're done - we'd love to see how Achilles looks on your shelf!

short_description: A true hero deserves a place on your shelf – time to make it happen! This free DLC gives you high-quality, 3D-printable STL files to create a detailed bust of Achilles. Perfect for collectors, hobbyists, and fans of Greek mythology, it’s your chance to bring the legend to life!
